component: Three-Unit Buildings in Low-Density Districts (file 2019-00217): up to 3 dwelling units on a zoning lot in R1, R1A, R2 and R2B (Minneapolis 2040 implementation)
coverage: Citywide low-density residential districts R1, R1A, R2, R2B (about half the city's land was single-family-only)
coding_notes: Adopted 11/08/19 (city archive); city announcement: 'scheduled to take effect Jan. 1, 2020'.
